title: A torsion-free counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes injectivity
summary: We disprove rational injectivity of the coefficient-free reduced Baum–Connes assembly map for torsion-free groups. Specifically, we construct a finitely generated torsion-free discrete group whose degree-zero assembly map has a kernel class of infinite order.

review.reason: Constructs a torsion-free group disproving rational injectivity of the reduced Baum–Connes map.
